help: Station classes and looks for this route (StationProfile). class: halt | rural | town | city (town: a loop and two more platform faces on the building side; city: loops and platforms both sides, full-length roofs, two foot over bridges, a big building). scheme: cream-maroon | yellow-red | white-blue | stone. canopy: shelter | long | cast-iron | steel | tiled. landmark: banyan | watertank | signalcabin | clock | garden | steamloco | viewdeck | well. stalls: tea, snacks, books, fruit. boards: extra boards by the name board. goods: true (or { side: 1 | -1, cargo: [...], sends: [...], receives: [...] }: what it loads into wagons and what wagons bring it, GoodsPlanner) for a goods line, loading platform and shed (side: +1 the Up side, -1 the Down side; Down trains run toward increasing km and use the -1 side). Anything left out is chosen from the station code (the same every run).
